name: a_base
eval: (()=>{ const w=window; const g=w.__engine.set.scene.getObjectByName('connor'); const mats=[]; g.traverse(o=>{ const m=o.material; if(!m) return; (Array.isArray(m)?m:[m]).forEach(x=>{ if(mats.indexOf(x)<0) mats.push(x); }); }); const flat=new (w.THREE_M||Object)(); w.__H={ g, mats, orig: mats.map(m=>({sheen:m.sheen, cc:m.clearcoat, env:m.envMapIntensity, ei:m.emissiveIntensity, ir:m.iridescence})), swapped:false, reset(){ this.mats.forEach((m,i)=>{ const o=this.orig[i]; if(o.sheen!==undefined)m.sheen=o.sheen; if(o.cc!==undefined)m.clearcoat=o.cc; if(o.env!==undefined)m.envMapIntensity=o.env; if(o.ei!==undefined)m.emissiveIntensity=o.ei; if(o.ir!==undefined)m.iridescence=o.ir; }); if(this.swapped){ this.swapped=false; this.g.traverse(o=>{ if(o.__om){ o.material=o.__om; o.__om=null; } }); } w.__engine.set.applyLook(w.__engine.fx); w.__engine.bypassPost=false; } }; void flat; })()

name: b_nobloom
eval: (()=>{ window.__H.reset(); const fx=window.__engine.fx; fx.setBloom(0,0,9); fx.setStreak(0); fx.wetLens=0; })()

name: d_noclearcoat
eval: (()=>{ window.__H.reset(); window.__H.mats.forEach(m=>{ if(m.clearcoat!==undefined) m.clearcoat=0; if(m.iridescence!==undefined) m.iridescence=0; }); })()

name: h_names
eval: (()=>{ window.__H.reset(); const rep=[]; window.__H.g.traverse(o=>{ if(!o.material) return; const ms=Array.isArray(o.material)?o.material:[o.material]; rep.push(o.name+' :: '+ms.map(m=>m.type+' sheen='+m.sheen+' cc='+m.clearcoat+' env='+m.envMapIntensity+' rough='+m.roughness+' col='+(m.color&&m.color.getHexString())).join(' | ')); }); console.error('MATREPORT '+JSON.stringify(rep)); })()
